home.title: The Quran Companion
home.subtitle: Find a committed partner to memorize and revise the Quran, online or near you.

guide.title: How it works
guide.s1d: With Google or your email, in a few seconds.
guide.s2d: Level, recitation, surahs, hizb memorized and availability. City and country only.
guide.s3d: Filter by level, language, country, schedule… among members of the same gender.
guide.s4d: Your WhatsApp is shared only after the request is accepted.
guide.s5d: Then set your status to “Partner found”.
guide.s6d: Reviews build trust. Every report is checked by the administrator.

hadith.text: “The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.”

auth.forgot_text: Enter your email: you will receive a link to choose a new password.
auth.pw_rule: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.check_email: Account created. Open the link sent to your email to confirm your address.
auth.reset_sent: If this address is registered, a link has just been sent.

err.pw_rule: The password must have at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
err.pw_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
err.not_confirmed: Address not confirmed. Open the link sent to your email.
err.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
err.google_off: Google sign-in is not available yet.
err.same_password: Choose a password different from the old one.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.required: Please fill in all required fields.
err.surah_order: The starting surah must come before the ending surah.
err.guardian: The guardian's name and WhatsApp are required.

profile.wa_private: Shared only after a request is accepted.
profile.pause_hint: It no longer appears in searches.

edit.intro: This information helps find the right partner. Only your city and country are shown, never your address.
edit.whatsapp_hint: With country code. Never public: shared only after acceptance.
edit.guardian_note: Under 18: contact goes through a parent or guardian.
edit.gender_locked: Gender can no longer be changed. Contact the administrator if it is wrong.

search.title: Find a partner
search.none: No member matches. Try widening the filters.
search.same_gender_rule: For everyone's peace of mind, connections are only between members of the same gender.

req.title: My requests
req.message_ph: Introduce yourself in a few words: your goals, your schedule…
req.minor_note: Once accepted, contact will be between your guardians.
req.was_declined: Your previous request was not accepted.
req.end_confirm: End the partnership with {name}? You can then choose another partner.
req.empty_out: You have not sent any requests.
req.err_dup: A request is already open with this member.
req.err_unavailable: This member is no longer available.
req.ended_note: Your partnership with this member has ended.
req.err_one_partner: One partner at a time: one of you already has an active partner. The current partnership must be ended first.

wa.adult: As-salamu alaykum {name}, I am {me} from Sahib Qurani. Our request was accepted: when would you like to start revising?
wa.minor: As-salamu alaykum, I am the guardian of {me} on Sahib Qurani. Our children were connected to revise the Quran with {name}. Can we arrange this?

rev.err_rating: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
rev.my_empty: You have not received any reviews yet.
rev.hide_hint: You can hide a review's comment; its rating still counts in your average.

safe.title: Report or block
safe.report_hint: Your report is confidential and will be reviewed by the administrator.
safe.err_dup: You already have an open report for this member.
safe.reported: Report sent. Thank you, it will be reviewed.
safe.block_hint: A blocked member can no longer see or contact you. Any connection between you ends.
safe.block_confirm: Block {name}? You will no longer see each other.

acct.delete_text: Your profile, requests, reviews and all your data will be permanently erased.
acct.delete_confirm1: Permanently delete your account and all your data? This cannot be undone.
acct.delete_mismatch: Incorrect confirmation word. Nothing was deleted.

admin.title: Admin area
admin.ban_confirm: Ban {name}? Their profile will be hidden and they can no longer send requests.
admin.wa_text: As-salamu alaykum {name}, this is the Sahib Qurani administrator.
admin.sh_hint: Each share contains a personal link: visits and sign-ups gained thanks to each member are counted. Country, city and language come from the sharer's profile.

pwa.title: Install the app
pwa.text: Open it straight from your home screen, like an app.
pwa.ios_safari: First open this site in Safari: installation only works from Safari.
pwa.ios_s1d: at the bottom of the screen (square with an arrow)
pwa.ios_s2d: Scroll the menu and tap this option.
pwa.ios_s3d: The Sahib Qurani icon appears on your home screen.

notif.title: Notifications on this device
notif.denied: Notifications blocked: allow them for this site in your browser settings.
notif.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
notif.ios_install: On iPhone, first install the app (“Install” button), then open it from its icon.
notif.server: Notification service unavailable at the moment.

share.msg:
Assalamu alaykum 🌿

partner.none_m: You don't have an active partner yet.
partner.none_f: You don't have an active partner yet.

leave.title: Before you go…
leave.text: Why are you leaving Sahib Qurani? (optional, anonymous)
leave.no_time: I don't have time any more

onb.check_email: Account created. Open the link sent to your e-mail: sign-up will then continue here.
onb.name_sub: No need for your real name: this is the name other members will see.
onb.gender_note: Gender cannot be changed later: you will only be matched with members of the same gender.
onb.age_sub: Your exact age is never asked. Under-18s are only matched with other under-18s.
onb.place_sub: Only your city and country are shown, never your address.
onb.contact_q: How do you prefer to revise?
onb.err_avail: Choose at least one time slot.
onb.intro: Sign-up in 9 short steps, about 2 minutes. Right after signing in, you will install the app: its icon will appear on your home screen, and you will complete your profile from the app.
onb.install_sub: Add Sahib Qurani to your home screen, then complete your profile from the app.
onb.inst_android: Tap “Install” and confirm. The icon appears on your home screen; open it to continue.
onb.inst_ios: On iPhone, a short guide appears (Safari's Share button). Then open the app from its icon and sign in once more: one tap with Google.
onb.inst_menu: Open your browser's ⋮ menu, then “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
onb.inst_done: Installed! Open Sahib Qurani from your home screen to continue your profile.
onb.relogin: First time opening the app: sign in once more to continue.
onb.cant_install: I can't install: continue on the website
onb.inst_then: Then close the browser and open the Sahib Qurani icon on your home screen.
onb.inst_open: Close the browser and open the Sahib Qurani icon to continue.

plan.tomorrow_hint_m: Well done! Now set tomorrow's plan.

plan.none_today_muraja: No revision planned for today yet.

plan.pick_hizb: Tap a hizb, then the thumn.
plan.done_hint_m: Well done! See you tomorrow, in shā’ Allāh.
plan.done_hint_f: Well done! See you tomorrow, in shā’ Allāh.
